labels.text: A usage allowance, free models only

S81.02.note: In this build only the signed-in plan is listed (the store purchase switch is off), and server enforcement is not visible in the UI.
steps: Sign in with a Free account and make sure chat is set to Cloud.
Open Settings and tap Subscription.
Tap What your plan includes.
Look for the Includes heading and the line A usage allowance, free models only, and compare with Expected.
S81.02.where: Settings > Subscription > What your plan includes

S81.03.note: No price appears on the plan screen; the price is only shown in the store sheet, which is off in this build.

S81.09.note: In this build the plan list shows only your own plan and the paywall Compare plans button is hidden, so differences are not shown side by side.
steps: Sign in with a Free account and make sure chat is set to Cloud.
Open Settings and tap Subscription.
Tap Compare plans and read the Includes list.
Trigger a gated feature in chat if one is available, then look for the sheet Not included in your plan and compare with Expected.

S81.14.needs: a Free account and a paid account to compare
S81.14.note: Server-side clamping is not visible in the UI, and the picker upgrade path does nothing while purchases are off; the effort control has no visible heading text in the code I read.
steps: Open a chat with chat set to Cloud.
Tap the model button; its label starts with Model: and the hint is Opens the model picker.
Pick a model that supports effort and look for the effort labels such as Balanced, Deep and Maximum.
Tap a locked model on a Free account and look for the See plans alert, and compare with Expected.
S81.14.where: Chat > Model button (shows Model: and the model name) > model picker

S81.15.needs: a Cloud account; reaching the cap needs heavy use
S81.15.note: The size of the flagship cap per plan is set on the server and is not shown as a number in the app.
steps: Sign in with a Cloud account and open Settings > Subscription.
Tap Usage.
Look under Weekly limits for the sub-bucket Most capable models, which appears only when the account has a flagship weekly reset.
Compare the percentage and reset time with Expected.

S81.23.note: Purchases are switched off (FEATURES.billing is false in apps/mobile/lib/v1FeatureFlags.ts and nativePurchases is false in apps/mobile/src/features/billing/storePurchases.json), so the effective-time text cannot be reached in this build.
steps: Sign in with a Free account and open Settings > Subscription.
Look at the Upgrade plan row.
Note that the row shows Unavailable in the app and cannot be pressed.
Compare with Expected: no charge or renewal date is shown before confirming, because purchases are off.

S81.25.needs: a test account with a failed renewal
S81.25.note: The code shows no grace window: the server comment says a lapsed paid plan is served as Free, and the support corpus says there is no grace period, so the Expected grace rule is not visible.
steps: Use a test account whose renewal failed (past due).
Open Settings > Subscription and read the status card line that says the subscription is past due.
Trigger a paid feature and look for the Update billing button in the paywall.
Compare with Expected: check what access remains and how to fix it.
S81.25.where: Settings > Subscription (status card), and the Update billing paywall

labels.text: Your plan, usage, and payment details

S81.27.needs: a second surface signed in to the same account
S81.27.note: The per-surface gate is enforced by the web gateway and was not checked here; the web comparison page was not located in this pass.
steps: Sign in with the same account on the phone app and on the web or desktop app.
On the phone, open Settings > Subscription and read the card Your plan, usage, and payment details.
On the other surface, open its billing or subscription page.
Compare the plan name on both surfaces with Expected.
S81.27.where: Settings > Subscription on each signed-in surface shows the same plan

labels.text: In-app purchases are not available yet

S81.28.note: In this build only your own plan is listed, so the Adds over lines and the paywall Compare plans button do not appear.
steps: Sign in with a Free account and open Settings > Subscription.
Read the card In-app purchases are not available yet, which says Compare plans shows what each plan adds.
Tap Compare plans and read the Includes list for the plan.
Compare with Expected: each plan should explain what it adds over the current plan.
